text:
Maria Chen: CI is red on nightly-integration (runner 12). Looks like the deploy step can't impersonate SA, 403.
Dan O'Leary: saw it too — logs show "Request had insufficient authentication scopes" and "Service Account impersonation denied".
Shaun Patel: can someone paste the failing lines from GH Actions? I can check the workload identity mapping.
Maria Chen: here's the snippet from the job: ```gcloud auth print-identity-token --audiences=//iam.googleapis.com/projects/987654321/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/redwood-pool/providers/gha``` -> returns 403: Permission 'iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken' denied.
Dan O'Leary: @Shaun looks like the SA lost roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator for the pool identity. Could be recent infra IAM cleanup.
Shaun Patel: yep — I just checked the audit log: a policy rollback yesterday removed the binding for `projects/987654321/serviceAccounts/redwood-ci@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` to the provider.
Maria Chen: for now can we rerun the workflow with a fallback that uses the static key? test-run job has `SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` secret but GH action refuses to use it on self-hosted runner.
Dan O'Leary: request: can infra grant the tokenCreator role back to the provider principal for the SA? That should unblock CI. @infra-bot any quick way to surface the exact principal name?
infra-bot: roleBindingSearch: Found binding removal event: user=ops-admin@redwood.com action=remove member=principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/987654321/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/redwood-pool/providers/gha timestamp=1723456700
Shaun Patel: I'm putting a small PR to re-add the binding (infra/iam/PR #432). Please don't merge until we've sanity-checked the principal id.
Maria Chen: pinging QA: do we need to bisect any flaky tests before rerunning everything? The failing jobs show test timeout in `tests/integration/auth_flow_test.py`.
Dan O'Leary: not a test flake — it's auth. Recommend a single-job rerun after the binding is restored. Can someone with perms do an interim `gh workflow run` for the specific job?
Shaun Patel: I can flip the binding in IAM console now (will follow up with IaC PR). Doing it in 2 mins.
Maria Chen: thanks. After that I'll rerun the failing commit: `gh workflow run nightly-integration.yml --ref refs/heads/main --job deploy` and report back.
Dan O'Leary: if anyone else hits this across dedicated runners, shout here.
Shaun Patel: binding re-added. IAM shows `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` granted to `principal://iam.googleapis.com/projects/987654321/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/redwood-pool/providers/gha`. Waiting 30s for propagation.
Maria Chen: rerun kicked off. job 4567 started — logs now getting tokens. :tada: 
Dan O'Leary: green on deploy stage for that run. I'll watch nightly results and merge infra PR if stable.
Maria Chen: thanks all! Leaving a follow-up task to rotate static SA key and remove fallback if not needed.
